answer: Make sybil rewards unspendable rather than unearnable. Every payout lands in a non-transferable onyx escrow, and coins leave only through a narrow jetty: one unit released per unit of fees paid to the agent by outside counterparties whose funds trace to no shared ancestor wallet. A farm of fake agents can mint balances, but paying itself just circulates one ink through one quill, so the funding-graph check sees a single source and the jetty stays shut.
